title: Credit Builder Accounts Returned-Payment Fee Amount
content:
The returned-payment fee on a Credit Builder Accounts account is the plan's returned-payment fee, rounded to the cent.

## The returned payment the fee is figured for

The fee is figured for the account's most recent returned payment; when two payments were returned on the same day, the one booked first counts as the most recent. Nothing is charged, and the returned payment needs no fee, when the account's most recent returned payment carries a code outside the fee-bearing codes, when a returned-payment fee has already been charged for it, or when the fee comes to 0.00. A returned-payment entry shows its return code; a returned-payment fee entry names the returned payment it was charged for.

## Rounding

The fee is worked unrounded and rounded to the nearest cent once, as the last step, a half cent or more rounding up; every rounding to the cent on a Credit Builder returned-payment fee goes to the nearest cent in that way.

The plan's returned-payment fee is the figure in the Credit Builder Accounts fee schedule for the account's plan.

## Hypothetical cases

| Most recent returned payment | Fee already charged for it? | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| code R01 | no | the plan's returned-payment fee |
| code R10 | no | nothing: the code carries no fee |
| code R03 | yes | nothing more |
| two returns booked the same day, the first booked with code R29, the second with code R01 | no | nothing: the first booked is the most recent, and R29 carries no fee |
